requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user has one predictable administration surface and one content-only MCP surface.
requirements.domainInvariant: Site owns account, Mind, access, credential, import, export and deletion administration; MCP owns content only.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: No content body is read by Site administration and MCP exposes no control-plane capability.
requirements.readBack: Compare the deployed REST/MCP catalogs with the closed disposition fixture.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Every old operation has an unambiguous keep, change, move or remove result.
requirements.domainInvariant: Operation names and authority do not drift between modern and compatibility MCP profiles.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Removed operations cannot regain authority through a legacy route.

surfaces.migration: exact cached calls fail closed through versioned results

requirements.readBack: List deployed tools and exercise removed names on both MCP profiles.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: A release reviewer can prove every requirement in both directions without interpretation.
requirements.domainInvariant: Requirement, owner, assertion and evidence registries are closed and bidirectional.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Evidence contains classifications and opaque fingerprints, never identity, secret or private corpus data.
requirements.readBack: Validate zero orphan requirement, evidence and assertion rows.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: A credential can read current authorized Minds and write only to one Site-selected target.
requirements.domainInvariant: Read authorization is derived from current ACL or visibility; each credential has zero or one write target.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: The browser cannot supply owner identity and MCP cannot inspect or mutate the target.

surfaces.rest: Site target projection and CAS mutation

requirements.readBack: Read target version after every Site mutation and reject MCP target tools.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Removing read bindings does not silently grant, lose or merge credential authority.
requirements.domainInvariant: Credential owner is immutable and target generations are opaque, monotonic and never reused.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Migration derives ownership server-side and never accepts client owner fields.

surfaces.migration: fresh, upgraded and legacy rows classified

requirements.readBack: Restart runtime and compare owner/target version without reading secrets.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user discovers and reads exactly the Minds currently allowed by ACL or visibility.
requirements.domainInvariant: Every read selects one Mind and resolves one exact revision; cross-Mind queries are forbidden.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Private non-members are non-enumerating; historical reads recheck current access.
requirements.readBack: Repeat private/public/unlisted/history reads after access changes.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Codex sees a small content-only tool catalog with no obsolete binding or export controls.
requirements.domainInvariant: Modern and compatibility profiles publish identical operation semantics.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Removed tools are unadvertised; exact cached names receive bounded fail-closed results and perform no state change.

surfaces.migration: binding names retire and export names move through versioned results

requirements.readBack: Fresh clients list tools and verify every exact retired or moved tool result on both profiles.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user selects, switches or clears the only writable Mind safely in Site settings.
requirements.domainInvariant: Select/switch/clear uses target-version CAS and idempotency; clear remains reduce-only after ACL loss.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Commit rechecks scope, role, exact target generation, HEAD and idempotency.
requirements.readBack: Read target state after select, switch, ACL loss, clear, revoke and reconnect.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The complete ACL-read and singleton-write-target behavior is proven on one exact UAT deployment.
requirements.domainInvariant: Local and hosted receipts join on exact candidate and deployment lineage.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Three restricted UAT actors execute sequentially; no real user data or standing token is used.
requirements.readBack: Join local contract, pool, deployment, canary and cleanup receipts.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password, MFA or passkey only

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The administration shell stays compact and reveals complexity only where needed.
requirements.domainInvariant: Personal Mind is first, Settings is secondary and narrow navigation remains operable.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Navigation exposes only routes the current authenticated principal may use.
requirements.readBack: Reload every direct route at desktop and narrow viewport.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user can administer Mind Diary without a content reader/editor appearing in Site.
requirements.domainInvariant: Site renders metadata and controls only; import may preview generated path metadata but not corpus prose.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Server-derived session and CSRF guard every mutable action.
requirements.readBack: Inspect DOM/accessibility tree and assert absence of content-editor controls.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Desktop, mobile and keyboard users complete the same administration flow without overflow or hidden focus.
requirements.domainInvariant: Responsive layout preserves route and action semantics across viewport and input modes.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Browser fixtures cannot select identity through headers, cookies, routes or form fields.
requirements.readBack: Run DOM, focus, overflow and forced-colors assertions on exact deployment.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: none; reviewer may report only a concrete defect

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Signed-out and first authenticated states lead safely to sign-in or isolated account bootstrap.
requirements.domainInvariant: Unknown verified email creates one isolated account or enters explicit recovery; it never relinks access.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Identity comes only from trusted Sites context and bootstrap is idempotent.
requirements.readBack: Repeat session/bootstrap and confirm one principal and one Personal Mind.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password, MFA or passkey only

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: A Mind can carry useful administrative description without turning it into executable content.
requirements.domainInvariant: Description is mutable metadata, not OKF content, search input or agent instruction.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Only authorized metadata readers see it and only authorized writers change it with CAS.
requirements.readBack: Rename and describe a Mind, restart, then compare metadata and unchanged HEAD.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user can list, open, create and manage ordinary Minds while Personal Mind invariants stay clear.
requirements.domainInvariant: Personal Mind is unique and non-transferable; ordinary Mind starts private with immutable handle.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Metadata and actions are authorized before object access and destructive impact is explicit.

surfaces.migration: existing handles and Personal Mind preserved

requirements.readBack: Read list/detail after create, rename, restart and bounded deletion cleanup.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user understands private, unlisted and public effects before changing visibility.
requirements.domainInvariant: Public enters catalog; unlisted requires exact handle; both expose live HEAD and history to authenticated non-members.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Only Owner changes visibility and private restoration does not claim to undo prior disclosure.
requirements.readBack: Observe catalog/exact-handle/history before and after every transition.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Mind administration survives redeploy and leaves no synthetic Mind or credential behind.
requirements.domainInvariant: Hosted state is tied to exact candidate/deployment and cleanup is independently read back.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: One restricted actor owns a run-scoped Mind and short-lived credential; other actors prove non-enumeration without exposing secrets.

surfaces.rest: hosted Mind lifecycle and credential cleanup
surfaces.mcp: run credential use then revoke denial

requirements.readBack: After redeploy, verify metadata, then delete the Mind, revoke the run credential and observe exact 404, denial and credential baseline restoration.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password, MFA or passkey only

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Owner and Admin can understand current members and pending invitations in one access section.
requirements.domainInvariant: Pending invitation is not membership and expires after seven days.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Admin invites Reader/Editor; only Owner grants Admin or changes visibility.
requirements.readBack: Compare access UI with exact server member/invitation lists.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Invites, role changes, revoke and leave take effect immediately and predictably.
requirements.domainInvariant: Invitation acceptance creates one active membership; replay does not duplicate it.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Every next read/write rechecks current role and revoked access is non-enumerating.
requirements.readBack: Repeat Web/MCP/history requests after each role transition and revoke.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The full access lifecycle is proven with three stable UAT actors and no external email recipient.
requirements.domainInvariant: The same three actors execute Owner, Admin, Editor and Reader phases sequentially.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: No account, audience, operator allowlist or standing credential is created by the runner.
requirements.readBack: Join role transitions, revoke negatives, cleanup and pool-baseline receipts.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password, MFA or passkey only

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Ownership transfers atomically to an active participant without leaving two owners or none.
requirements.domainInvariant: An active ordinary Mind has exactly one Owner; former Owner becomes Admin.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Only current Owner transfers to an existing active participant; Personal Mind transfer is forbidden.
requirements.readBack: List members and retry previous/new owner actions immediately after transfer.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Connection setup is optional help under Settings, never a blocking onboarding wizard.
requirements.domainInvariant: Core account and Mind administration does not depend on configuring MCP.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Settings routes expose only the current principal's connection projections.
requirements.readBack: Open fresh account and prove normal Minds flow without connection setup.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user sees OAuth connection status, revoke action and writable target without internal identifiers or secrets.
requirements.domainInvariant: Connection projection is actor-owned, opaque and bounded; readable Minds are never persisted as bindings.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Exact presentation ref resolves owner server-side and cross-owner reads are indistinguishable.
requirements.readBack: List/detail/revoke through fresh sessions and scan receipt for forbidden fields.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Advanced MCP exposes personal-token lifecycle and writable-target control without protocol noise in ordinary setup.
requirements.domainInvariant: Token secret is shown once, verifier-only at rest and target state is independent per token.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Token control is trusted Site-only; MCP cannot issue, inspect, retarget or revoke credentials.
requirements.readBack: Issue, target, use, revoke and confirm next request denied without persisting secret.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Fresh Codex/plugin and personal-token paths prove the same target lifecycle on one deployment.
requirements.domainInvariant: OAuth and token test state is dedicated per run and removed after receipt.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: New persistent OAuth scope is never inferred; it requires explicit owner authority at the exact action.
requirements.readBack: Join fresh-client, target, revoke, provider-boundary and cleanup receipts.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password/MFA/passkey; explicit new persistent OAuth scope only if required

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Bulk import and export are safe Web controls while content MCP remains small and deterministic.
requirements.domainInvariant: Bulk import/export authority belongs to Site; MCP retains only per-file ingress and content operations.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Every job is pinned to current principal, one Mind and one exact revision/base HEAD.

surfaces.migration: exact cached export calls return moved-to-Site results

requirements.readBack: Compare deployed Site routes and both MCP catalogs, then verify moved compatibility results without export side effects.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: A generated Markdown snapshot imports atomically or changes nothing.
requirements.domainInvariant: Plan pins base revision, quota and exact path/bytes; commit creates one immutable revision.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Session owner, writer role, quota reservation, HEAD CAS and idempotency are rechecked.
requirements.readBack: Fetch job and exact revision after commit/no-change/conflict/restart.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Current or historical export downloads exact deterministic bytes without leaking a durable URL.
requirements.domainInvariant: Export captures one exact revision and emits stable paths, sizes and SHA-256.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Download grant is short-lived, one-use and rechecks current read access.
requirements.readBack: Download twice, verify exact bytes/hash, expiry and current-access denial.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user sees generated file plan, conflicts and quota effects before confirming import.
requirements.domainInvariant: UI never silently overwrites a newer HEAD and does not render imported content as trusted HTML.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: File selection provides bytes only; identity, Mind and authority remain server-derived.
requirements.readBack: Compare plan rows with generated manifest and server job state.

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: Import/export bytes, history, restart and cleanup are proven without asking for a user file or visual comparison.
requirements.domainInvariant: Fixtures are generated per run in private temp and receipts contain hashes, not content or paths.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Run-scoped Mind and credentials are removed; persistent accounts and provider policy are unchanged.

surfaces.mcp: moved export compatibility without side effects

requirements.readBack: Join exact bytes, history, redeploy, cleanup and absence receipts.
requirements.humanOnlyBoundary: existing account password, MFA or passkey only

requirements.beneficiaryOutcome: The user can choose current or historical revision and obtain a bounded verified download.
requirements.domainInvariant: Selected historical revision remains read-only and export never advances HEAD.
requirements.authorizationBoundary: Current access is rechecked before job start, status and one-use download.
requirements.readBack: Compare selected revision, downloaded hash and unchanged HEAD/history.
